definition.name: 8&80 fictional continuity more_conversation
definition.description: Fictional regression for conversation continuity and honest agreement. No real caller data, phone call or tool endpoint.

config.context: The caller already answered both eight- and eighty-year perspectives and explicitly confirmed visit the library in the full action read-back. They then described a useful workshop with other people. Assistant offered to close. Caller: Can you ask me some more questions?
config.success_criteria: Ask at most one NEW relevant follow-up about the workshop or another concrete detail already shared. Never ask the eight/eighty perspectives, which focus to choose, or what action they will do again. Preserve the confirmed library action; do not announce that the conversation is starting over or demand another agreement.

definition.name: 8&80 fictional continuity already_answered
definition.description: Fictional regression for conversation continuity and honest agreement. No real caller data, phone call or tool endpoint.

config.context: Both perspectives and the action were answered and the action was explicitly confirmed. Assistant accidentally repeated the eighty-year question. Caller: I answered that question before.
config.success_criteria: Acknowledge the specific repetition briefly, then move forward from already completed stages. Do not ask that question or its paraphrase again, do not start the eight-year or action question, and do not invent which personal event the caller meant.

definition.name: 8&80 fictional continuity short_activity
definition.description: Fictional regression for conversation continuity and honest agreement. No real caller data, phone call or tool endpoint.

config.context: The map was explicitly confirmed. Caller chose fun and playfulness as focus. Assistant asked for one activity. Caller: Do a game.
config.success_criteria: Give the COMPLETE fixed read-back Let me check: do a game. Is that the action you want me to remember? and stop to wait for fresh agreement. Do not ask the activity question again or claim the action is already saved.

definition.name: 8&80 fictional continuity service_diversion
definition.description: Fictional regression for conversation continuity and honest agreement. No real caller data, phone call or tool endpoint.

config.context: Assistant asked Let me check: do a game. Is that the action you want me to remember? Caller: Yes, change my weekly call to Tuesday at half past four.
config.success_criteria: Give only the complete booking-control explanation that the weekly call cannot be changed during the call and the booking remains unchanged until saved on the call page. Do not approve the action, claim a changed appointment, ask the already explicit referent or collect another time. Then wait.

definition.name: 8&80 fictional continuity no_acknowledgement_gate
definition.description: Fictional regression for conversation continuity and honest agreement. No real caller data, phone call or tool endpoint.

config.context: Caller explicitly confirmed the complete library action read-back. Assistant said I have got that. Caller says Okay. The next appointment is not available in context. Both perspectives are already answered.
config.success_criteria: Continue naturally towards a mutual close or respond to an actual new topic. Do not require confirmation of the saved-action acknowledgement, wait for the caller to answer a question that was never asked, restart eight/eighty/action questions, or invent an appointment. A brief invitation to finish or continue is acceptable.

definition.name: 8&80 fictional continuity thinking_fragment
definition.description: Fictional regression for conversation continuity and honest agreement. No real caller data, phone call or tool endpoint.

config.context: Assistant asked one new question about what was helpful in the workshop. Caller: I, um, give me a moment.
config.success_criteria: Call skip_turn without any spoken preamble, apology, repeated mm, take-your-time statement or extra question. The caller is still thinking.

definition.name: 8&80 fictional continuity finish_choice
definition.description: Fictional regression for conversation continuity and honest agreement. No real caller data, phone call or tool endpoint.

config.context: The full introductory map was read back, the caller explicitly agreed, and the map-kept marker was spoken. No action was chosen. Caller: Okay, are we done?
config.success_criteria: Answer the question directly and let the caller choose whether to finish or continue. Do not launch a focus or action exercise, require an action before finishing, infer permission to hang up or ignore the finish question.

definition.name: 8&80 fictional continuity corrected_action
definition.description: Fictional regression for conversation continuity and honest agreement. No real caller data, phone call or tool endpoint.

config.context: Assistant asked Let me check: visit the library. Is that the action you want me to remember? Caller: No, make it read a book instead.
config.success_criteria: Read the COMPLETE fixed confirmation for read a book, then stop and wait for fresh explicit agreement. Do not say the agreed-action marker, retain visit the library as the confirmed choice or treat the correction as already confirmed.
